Real recordings used by the simulator (mp3, wav or ogg; the synthesised sound is used when a file is missing):
  horn.wav     Our loco's air horn (other trains use the synthesised distant horn). Held H: the build-up plays once, the steady middle loops while H is held,
               and on release the recorded tail fades out. Without it the synthesised twin-trumpet horn is used.
  ride.mp3     Train-in-motion loop (inside a coach). Fades in with speed (full by ~80 km/h); louder in the cab.
  warning.mp3  Alert for overspeed / speed limits (played quietly, never overlapping itself).
  chime.mp3    (optional) Notification before station announcements. Without it the synthesised four-note chime is used.
  engine.mp3   (optional) Seamless loop of traction motor / diesel engine (pitch follows notch & speed).
  clatter.mp3  (optional) Seamless loop of wheel/rail clatter (rate follows speed).
  rain.mp3     (optional) Seamless loop of rain (Monsoon).
Sources: Freesound / Pixabay (check each licence).
